description: Migration window: procedure carrying its name only on the deprecated health:procedureName spelling
notes: This is exactly what a C-CDA import path emits today: a record typed clinical:Procedure whose name is written to health:procedureName, a predicate no Cascade vocabulary defines. Under clinical v1.14 it FAILED clinical:ProcedureShape's name requirement while carrying a name. clinical v1.15 satisfies that requirement through an sh:or over both spellings, so the record validates without being rewritten. It also raises a WARNING from clinical:ProcedureNameSpellingShape, which this suite does not observe: extract_violations() keeps only sh:Violation results. The warning is the signal that the window is still open, and it is verified in cascade-cli rather than here. When the window closes this fixture becomes a NEGATIVE and its expectation must be inverted, not deleted.
